subject: English First Additional Language

source.subtopic: Understands and uses the past tense ('Yesterday I made a mask')

show.line: Yesterday I made a mask! Made, cut, painted. These words tell us about the past.

rounds.prompt: Yesterday I ... a mask. Make or made?
rounds.praise: Yes! Yesterday I made a mask.

rounds.prompt: Yesterday I ... it yellow. Paint or painted?
First I cut. Then I painted. Finally I... what?

hints: Many past words end with ed. Painted, glued.

beat_the_tutor.setup: My turn! Yesterday I... let me say it.
beat_the_tutor.win_line: You caught me! Yesterday I made a mask.
beat_the_tutor.gentle_line: Let's say it together. Yesterday I made a mask!

parent_line: Can talk about the past: yesterday I made, I cut, I painted.
